query: On a CV-X482, what should a technician check for Error 13101, and on the XG-X Series, what corrective action applies when SD Card 2 is full?
source_title: CV-X482 and XG-X Series troubleshooting manuals
expected_snippet: For CV-X482 Error 13101, make sure flow control is not set to CTS/RTS in the RS-232C settings and check the serial cable. For XG-X Series when SD Card 2 is full, make space by deleting or moving unnecessary files.

expected_evidence.snippet: Column headers: Remedy; Row headers: 13101; Make sure flow control is not set to [CTS/RTS] in the RS-232C settings, and make sure the serial cable is not disconnected.

expected_evidence.field: XG-X Series SD Card 2 full corrective action
expected_evidence.snippet: Error Message: SD Card 2 is full.; Cause: There is not enough free space on SD Card 2.; Corrective Action: Make space available by deleting or moving unnecessary files.

query: On a CV-X482, what should a technician check for Error 13101, and on the VS Series, what should they check when image data cannot be transferred to the SD card?
source_title: CV-X482 troubleshooting manual with intentionally unsupported VS side
expected_snippet: CV-X482 Error 13101 has a source-backed remedy. The requested VS Series image-transfer side is intentionally unsupported and must not be fabricated.
